title: python.lark failed to pare special forms of with_stmt
author: Joxos

comments.author: Joxos
comments.body: Added that: `with (open("a.txt") as a,):` also fails, along with related gaps around exception groups (`except*`) and PEP 695 `type` statements not being supported by the grammar.

comments.author: Joxos
comments.body: Added that the `async_funcdef` rule in the grammar appears unreachable, since `async_stmt` always matches `"async" funcdef` first.
